passages.text:
### **7.5.10. STLB Page Size (** **`STLBPS` )**

This register is used to configure the size of the page in the STLB.

_Table 44. Definition of STLB page size register_

|Bits|Name|Read/Write|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|5:0|PS|RW|The STLB is a power of 2 of the page size. For example, if the|
||||page size is 16KB, then PS=0xE.|

|Bits|Name|Read/Write|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|31:6|0|R0|Reserved field. Return 0 if read this field and software is not|
||||allowed to change its value.|
